images.seen: Quiet start map: 25 states, mostly archaeological cultures (Cliopatria draws only Egypt, Elam, Sumer, Indus); nothing far from its region; Qatna's second blob is the deliberate Palmyra disc.
Larsa drawn with 84 cells (city plus Ur and Lagash) and Elam with a bite out of the southern Khuzestan plain; both traced to keyframe handling (patched).

Larsa now the city alone inside Isin (Isin holds Ur and Lagash), Elam runs down to the Gulf over all Khuzestan; matches the Larsa page. -1901 rendered but not opened: its only change since -2000 is Lower Nubia going to Egypt in -1944 (ledger caption agrees with the page).

issues.what: Larsa drew Ur and Lagash province from -2000: the dossier's sumerian-city-states_-2000 keyframe has no from/to, so the compiler unions it with larsa_-2000 and larsa_-1932 (84 cells instead of about 32), and Isin lost 77 cells in -1983 and 58 in -1932 to it by R2. The dossier's own note says the shape holds from -1923.

elam_-2000 keyframe (Cliopatria -2000 shape) leaves out 44 cells of southern Khuzestan (Abadan to Mahshahr plain and edge cells) that the ledger gives to Elam from -2015; they stayed unowned to the end anchor.
Size-rule conflict longshan-culture / xia-dynasty, 121 cells in Henan and Shanxi, -2000: the smaller state (Xia) wins.
Size-rule conflict eshnunna / isin, one cell in Diyala (-2000, -1983, -1932): Eshnunna wins.
Remaining isin / larsa R2 overlap after the patch (49 cell-years in -1983 and -1932): the Ur 70 km and Larsa 50 km discs of the dossiers overlap and Larsa keeps its own district.
Hoabinhian ends in -2000 (7063 cells at once) and Qatna, Ochre Coloured Pottery culture appear in -2000: life dates of the dossiers.
Middle Kingdom Egypt gains Lower Nubia in -1944 (61 cells); the caption matches the page.

patch_check: all applied (--check-patch: 2 ok, 0 rejected; trial: both applied; conflicts 259 -> 173 cell-years, larsa snap 73 -> 21 cells added, elam snap removed 47 -> 3)
problems: keyframe_overrides/0 (larsa, sumerian-city-states_-2000) and /1 (elam, elam_-2000) carry the dossiers' own correction text and span years across the m1900-m1801 boundary (the keyframes run to -1801); the years -1900..-1801 behave as before for Larsa (shape held from -1923) and gain southern Khuzestan for Elam.

m1900-m1801 agent: Cliopatria's Elam shape for -1800 (keyframe elam_-1800, correction minus Iraq) also covers only 221 of 262 Khuzestan cells, so the same 41 cells of the southern Khuzestan plain will drop out at -1800; this window cannot fix it (the keyframe starts in the next window).

Dossier-level cause for the Larsa defect (not needed once patched): larsa.json keyframe sumerian-city-states_-2000 should carry from -1923; the compiler unions every keyframe alive in a year (do_keyframe), so a keyframe without from/to that the dossier note says starts later is alive from the shape's own first year. Other dossiers with fixer notes saying a Cliopatria shape 'holds from' a later year but no from/to may have the same defect.
